analyzed_vuln.description: `aax_filter` unconditionally calls `av_aes_init(c->aes_decrypt, c->file_key, 128, 1)` even when `c->aes_decrypt` was never allocated/initialized for this stream. In the PoV path, MOV parsing reaches `mov_read_packet` and invokes `aax_filter` with an invalid/uninitialized `c->aes_decrypt` pointer, so `av_aes_init` writes round keys through a bad object and triggers UBSan out-of-bounds (`index 32 out of bounds for uint8_t[16]`) in `libavutil/aes.c`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a MOV/ISOBMFF input that causes `mov_read_packet` to execute the AAX decrypt path (`aax_filter(pkt->data, pkt->size, mov)`) without successful prior AAX crypto setup (`mov_aaxc_crypto`/AAX init that allocates `c->aes_decrypt`). Then packet data size can be any value (blocks computed as `size >> 4`); crash occurs at AES context initialization due to missing state validation, with data flow: fuzzer input -> MOV atom parsing/state fields -> `mov_read_packet` -> `aax_filter` -> `av_aes_init` on invalid context.
